This section collects source-collection stubs for research areas relevant to the site's main topics. The individual review pages are intentionally conservative: they identify review questions and source links, but they do not yet claim to synthesize the literature.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Current Status

Each review page below is still incomplete. Treat these pages as review scaffolds until they include paper-by-paper summaries, extracted evidence, and explicit limitations. Expected completion: 2026-Q4.
:::

## Current Review Topics

- [Interaction Forces in the Golf Swing](research-review-interaction-forces.html) [Planned]{.status-badge .status-badge--planned}: source-collection stub for interaction forces, segment sequencing, and golf-specific evidence gaps.
- [Induced Acceleration Analysis](research-review-induced-acceleration-analysis.html) [Planned]{.status-badge .status-badge--planned}: source-collection stub for force-contribution and acceleration-decomposition methods.
- [Baseball Pitching Biomechanics](research-review-baseball-pitching.html) [Planned]{.status-badge .status-badge--planned}: source-collection stub for cross-sport comparison material relevant to multi-segment throwing motions.
- [Shaft Flexibility in Golf Swing Dynamics](research-review-shaft-flexibility.html) [Planned]{.status-badge .status-badge--planned}: source-collection stub for shaft bending, stiffness, flexible-club modeling, and fitting claims.
